column1: # The exe's imports in its own import-directory order (DLL, then IAT slot), as the `__imp_'
# symbols our objects reference. mwld numbers a DLL's IAT in the order the link first
# references each import; tools/pullorder.py references these first, in this order, except
# the ones tools/thunkorder.tsv places (their thunk is emitted where the import is pulled).
# Read off the exe's import directory (lane QBQ, 2026-10-06); not listed: COMCTL32.dll ordinal 17.
# The exe also holds two EMPTY descriptors, OPENGL32.dll and VERSION.dll (a terminator-only IAT
# each): the descriptor of a DLL whose one import a dead-stripped function pulled. Nothing in
# the tree calls them, so their rows name the import library's descriptor member itself and are
# named whether or not an input references them (link.ps1 lists opengl32.lib for it).
